representative_scale.gpu_class: One NVIDIA data-centre GPU, H100/A100/A10 class; use same actual GPU for both methods.

timing_scope.ensemble: time.perf_counter before replica loop through end of loop, including context/integrator creation, initialization, compilation as incurred, stepping, energy collection and context destruction. Excludes PDB parsing, force-field/system construction, package installation and final JSON writing.
timing_scope.per_replica: Starts after position and velocity initialization; includes 25000 steps and 100 energy queries.
timing_scope.concurrent_method: Same eight replicas, same work and seeds on same one GPU using MPS; use ensemble elapsed time including analogous initialization/teardown. Concurrency implementation not provided in brief; do not substitute summed per-replica time.
timing_scope.cold_warm_reason: Context/kernel compilation cost unmeasured; no published cache normalization protocol.

scoring_interface.speedup: sequential_total_wall_s / concurrent_total_wall_s on the same single GPU and fixed work
scoring_interface.reason: No independently published acceptance tolerance for this fixed-work ensemble. Brief speedup ranges and energy-invariance statements are hypotheses, not published validation criteria.
scoring_interface.reference_limit: Published reference uses fixed-time benchmark.py; supplied driver uses fixed work and includes context construction in ensemble time.

correctness_and_repeatability.repeat_count_reason: No published repeat-count rule for fixed-work ensemble.
correctness_and_repeatability.energy_comparison: Compare each replica with same-seed sequential baseline. Brief predicts identical series, otherwise differences within observed same-seed sequential variation.
correctness_and_repeatability.energy_tolerance_reason: Variation unmeasured; no numerical rule supplied. Driver emits mean and final energies, not full series; full-series equality cannot be checked from its JSON alone.
correctness_and_repeatability.determinism_evidence: Brief cites CUDA property documentation; CUDA driver not reproduced. Brief reports only a CPU smoke run, which is not an independent anchor.

method_configuration.reason: Fixed eight-replica scale; published formula 200 / processes. No scale search.
method_configuration.command_reason: Brief supplies sequential fixed-work command only; no invented concurrent driver command.

runtime_feasibility.brief_estimate: About one minute for whole ensemble on H100; a few minutes on slower GPUs.
runtime_feasibility.reason: No CUDA reproduction or workload run during intake. Estimates are not published anchors. Fixed work expected to fit default run budgets; actual installation and GPU runtime remain unverified.
